title: What Transfers Across Protein Pockets? Experience Reuse in Molecular Optimization for Agentic Structure-Based Drug Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.32620v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents optimize a ligand in a protein pocket by editing it step by step and docking each edit. Recent agents first spend extra dockings probing the complex with controlled edits; guidance induced from these probes is reported to help more than the chemical knowledge the model already carries. The probes are then discarded with the instance that produced them, so the obvious next step is to keep them in an experience base, letting a new pocket inherit what earlier ones already paid for. Such a base is read through a \emph{key}: the record properties under which past edits are pooled and a new one is looked up. Using the full log of one such run over the CrossDocked2020 test-set pockets, we ask whether its keys recur on a pocket the base has never seen and still separate improving from worsening edits. \crchange{Using} the contacts at the site being edited, the action, and the round as \crchange{a} key, the base separates them sharply.

translated_title: 蛋白质口袋之间什么可以迁移？面向智能体结构导向药物设计的分子优化经验复用
translated_abstract: LLM智能体通过逐步编辑配体并对每次编辑进行对接，来优化蛋白质口袋中的配体。近期的智能体首先花费额外的对接次数、通过受控编辑来探测复合物；据报告，从这些探测中获得的指导比模型已有的化学知识更有帮助。然而，这些探测结果随后会与产生它们的实例一起被丢弃，因此显而易见的下一步是将它们保存在一个经验库中，让新的口袋能够继承先前的口袋已经付出代价换来的经验。这样的经验库通过一个“键”来读取：即依据哪些记录属性来汇集过去的编辑并查找新的查询。利用某次运行中针对CrossDocked2020测试集口袋的完整日志，我们研究这些键是否在经验库从未见过的口袋上依然出现，并且依然能够区分改善性编辑与恶化性编辑。结果表明，使用被编辑位点的接触信息、动作和轮次作为键，经验库能够清晰地将二者区分开来。
tldr: 该研究提出以编辑位点接触、动作和轮次为键的经验库，证明了分子优化中的探测经验可以跨蛋白质口袋迁移复用，在从未见过的口袋上仍能清晰区分改善性与恶化性的编辑。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an experience base keyed by edited-site contacts, actions, and rounds, demonstrating that probing experience from molecular optimization transfers across protein pockets and sharply separates improving from worsening edits even on previously unseen pockets.
